_comment: Spoken text for the recorded voiceover of 'Your statement in 60 seconds', one line per caption cue. 'caption' must equal the player's caption for that cue (YES.overview.video.cues()); scripts/voiceover.mjs refuses to record if they differ, so the narration can never drift from the statement. 'voice' is what the narrator says: the same words, with amounts and dates written out so they are read exactly.
